dog.description_text: Meet Thursday — New Arrival! Thursday, a three-month-old male currently weighing 14 lbs., just arrived at the adoption center and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Since Thursday is a recent arrival, we don’t have much background information or many personality notes yet, but we’ll be updating their profile as we get to know them better. Every day reveals something new, and we’re excited to learn all the little quirks, preferences, and habits that make them unique. If you’re open to a little patience and a lot of possibility, come meet Thursday! You might be the person who helps them feel safe, confident, and right at home. Check back for updates—or stop by to say hello and discover who Thursday is becoming. We are located at 307 W Broadway and open 11am-7pm, 7 days a week (excluding major holidays).
